tools.name: global_search
tools.description: Search the KaliCart Global federated index: real product offers across independent WooCommerce merchants that opted in via the ARC (Agent-Readable Catalog) protocol. Returns merchant-authoritative prices, UCP availability_status, storefront URLs and canonical category leaves. Provide q (free text) a

tools.name: lookup_merchant
tools.description: Check whether a merchant domain runs an ARC-compliant catalog (KaliCart Bridge). Returns bridge_version, merchant discovery URL and federated-indexing consent flags. A miss schedules a background probe. Use when you already know a merchant domain (verify ARC support, get its discovery URL); to disco

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve full product detail from the KaliCart Global federated index by p2209_id. Returns price, availability, attributes, variants, and a direct storefront URL for checkout handoff. Obtain p2209_id from global_search results.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List WooCommerce merchants participating in the KaliCart Global federated catalog. Returns merchant domain, storefront URL, and product count. Use before global_search to understand catalog coverage.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List canonical product category leaves used by KaliCart Global with product counts. Use to discover available categories before filtering global_search with the leaf parameter.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "global_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
